meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写好或写了一半的小说导进写作项目,接着往下写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有完本或半成品小说,想放进统一流程继续创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import your finished or half-written novel into a project and keep writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a finished or half-written novel and want to keep writing it in one flow.

howto.what: 把作者已有的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析成标准写作工程：拆文库分析资产加设定、大纲、正文、追踪目录，并按篇幅长短自动分流，导入后可直接续写。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-import，或说「导入小说」「把我的书导进来」这类指令，想把已写好的书导进项目继续写时触发。

say.text: 导入我这本书，文件路径是 ~/book.txt
say.note: 会先确认导入源、题材和篇幅类型

say.text: 只做拆文库分析，不用建可续写的工程
say.note: 走到拆文库为止，不做结构迁移

say.text: 我写到第80章了，导入后接着写第81章
say.note: 残稿会问你是续写还是先补完

howto.what_en: It reverse-parses an existing novel (draft or finished) into a standard writing project: analysis assets under 拆文库 plus 设定/大纲/正文/追踪 folders, routed by length, ready to continue writing.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-import, or phrases like "import novel" and "reverse-parse", when you want an existing book brought into the project to keep writing.

say_en.text: Import my novel; the file is at ~/book.txt
say_en.note: Asks about source, genre and length first

say_en.text: Just analyze it into 拆文库, no writing project
I'm at chapter 80; import then write chapter 81
say_en.note: Asks how to treat an incomplete chapter
